scenarios.name: Valid authentication request
scenarios.details: Authenticated request with valid Bearer token returns schema-valid response

scenarios.name: Invalid request payload schema validation
scenarios.details: Empty body or missing required fields triggers standard HTTP 422 validation error

scenarios.name: Upload valid document multipart
scenarios.details: Valid PDF multipart upload returns HTTP 202 with doc_id and status=pending

scenarios.name: Upload unsupported file type
scenarios.details: Unsupported media type triggers controlled rejection with allowed MIME list

scenarios.name: Get document processing status
scenarios.details: Status returns valid state among [pending, indexing, ready, failed]

scenarios.name: Search query response structure
scenarios.details: Search returns query string, items, and confidence metrics

scenarios.name: Evidence-grounded answer generation
scenarios.details: Answer response includes grounded answer, citations list, and warnings

scenarios.name: Citation resolution precision
scenarios.details: Citations strictly reference existing document ID and page number

scenarios.name: Generate synthesized report
scenarios.details: Report generation endpoint returns 201 with report ID and artifact paths

scenarios.name: Unauthenticated access attempt
scenarios.details: Missing credentials reject immediately with HTTP 401 Unauthorized

scenarios.name: Anti-IDOR cross-tenant document request
scenarios.details: Cross-tenant request returns HTTP 404 to prevent resource existence enumeration

scenarios.name: Non-existent document lookup
scenarios.details: Query for unknown doc_id returns structured 404 error envelope

scenarios.name: Contract failure on missing required field
scenarios.details: Frontend apiRequest safeParse detects missing fields and raises ApiError

scenarios.name: Breaking change schema detection
scenarios.details: Schema analyzer flags breaking removals or type shifts between API versions

scenarios.name: Service timeout and failure handling
scenarios.details: Downstream model timeout triggers controlled 504 gateway timeout envelope
